olivia: Quick postmortem follow-upwe need concrete owners for the regression and chaos items discussed. I'll list proposals here so we can convert to GH issues.

ben: I'll pick up the regression harness for the hallucination case. Deliverable: curated prompt set + automated eval job that fails the build on regression. Target: PR by Friday.
kai: I'll take the KV eviction load test. Plan: add two scenarios to load-tests/kv-eviction.yaml: steady-state (1h) and spike (10m). Will include prometheus metrics export and a Grafana dashboard panel. ETA Wednesday.
lina: I'll design the chaos drill (simulated node loss + kv eviction + degraded storage). Deliverables: runbook, blast radius table, tabletop script. Propose drill date: 2 weeks from now.
olivia: For tracking, let's standardize issue metadata. Template fields to include: incident link, owner, deliverable type (prompt-set / regression / load-test / chaos), repo path, ETA, validation criteria, rollback plan, and stakeholders. Example body below:

```
Incident: <link to postmortem>
Owner: @
Deliverable: regression prompt set
Repo: redwood/evals
ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
Validation: eval name: kv-hallucination-check; gating: fail CI on >3% drop in accuracy over baseline
Rollback: revert PR and disable scheduled runs
Stakeholders: eng-sre, eng-ml, product
```

ben: I'll open the GH issue and tag `postmortem-followup` + `eval`. Also adding a `verification` checklist to require an owner to attach run logs.

ops-bot: GH issue created: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/789 :robot_face:

kai: About scheduling: recommend an initial daily run at 03:30 UTC for the new regression suite, then scale to tri-weekly if stable after 10 successful runs. Cron suggestion: `30 3 * * * /opt/bin/run-evals --suite=kv-hallucination --report=evals-api`
lina: For chaos blast radius, proposing three tiers: small (single pod eviction, no traffic shift), medium (25% capacity drop + kv eviction), large (region-level degraded storage). Table will map expected customer impact and rollback steps.
olivia: Also flagging a recurring incident pattern: KV-related incidents every ~21 days. Action item: create a synthetic workload generator that replays traffic distributions across a 21-day window and feed it into nightly load tests. Owner?
kai: I'll prototype the generator as a small python utility and add sample configs under load-tests/tools/synth-gen. It will support `--window-days=21` and a seed for determinism.
ben: For validation gates, propose thresholds: accuracy delta > 3% OR tail latency (p99) increase > 20% -> create an alert and open an auto ticket. How do we want auto ticketing implemented?
olivia: Console should create an auto-ticket after 3 consecutive failing runs for a suite. Add a dashboard route `postmortem-evals` with per-suite trends and quick links to GH issues. Owner for dashboard? @ben help wire eval results -> console.
ben: On it. I'll wire the webhook from evals-runner to console and add the alert -> ticket mapping. ETA: 5 days.
lina: Scheduling the tabletop: I'll book an ops slot and send invites this afternoon. Also will prepare an incident-play script so on-call folks can run through the steps.

olivia: Finalizing action list here (to be copied into the postmortem):
- Curate prompt set & eval harness (owner: ben, repo: redwood/evals, ETA: Fri)
- KV eviction load test + prometheus export + grafana panel (owner: kai, repo: redwood/load-tests, ETA: Wed)
- Synthetic 21-day workload generator (owner: kai, repo: redwood/load-tests/tools, ETA: Mon next week)
- Chaos drill runbook + tabletop (owner: lina, calendar: quarterly-chaos, ETA: 2 weeks)
- Issue template + GH issue + labels `postmortem-followup` (owner: ben, ETA: today)
- Console dashboard + auto-ticketing after 3 failures (owner: ben, ETA: 5 days)
- Initial schedule: daily regression run at 03:30 UTC for 10 days, then 3x/week (owner: kai)

ben: I'll open all issues and link PRs back to the postmortem. ping @eng-sre for review on the load-test configs once PRs are up.

ops-bot: CI: load-tests branch kai/kv-evict-config passed lint and unit tests :white_check_mark:
olivia: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem and add the GH issue links there. If any dates slip, reassign on the GH project board.
